## Type of Change

## Privacy & Architecture Checklist
- [ ] **100% Client-Side**: No user files or sensitive data are sent to any external server.
- [ ] **TypeScript**: Strict types used, zero type errors (`npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] **Tests**: Tested locally with `npm run test` and `npm run test:logic`.
- [ ] **Responsive Design**: Tested on mobile and desktop viewports.
- [ ] **Accessibility**: ARIA labels, focus states, and keyboard navigation tested.
